source_snapshot.procedure: Generic setup says clear logs; open Hardware Status > Sensors and compare each sensor reading/setting with BMC sensor spec.
source_snapshot.criteria: Sensor reading and threshold are human readable and match specification.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES assumes a literal unique sensor and truncates fallback output; it omits DCSCM FRU/instance/topology, sensing point, capability/units/scaling, WebUI/spec/freshness and safe Script review.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION treats DCSCM identity/specification as prerequisites and keeps the test read-only.

old_problem: The proposed command did not establish which DCSCM FRU/instance or physical sensing point owned the value. Component-local temperature was not separated from ambient, threshold capability/N/A rules and operating condition were absent, and incomplete output plus an unreviewed shared Script could not prove WebUI/spec agreement.
disposition_reason: The read-only intent is clear. Join the exact DCSCM FRU/serial/instance and topology to one stable sensor and WebUI row, record load/airflow, collect the complete capability-aware record and compare all applicable fields with the versioned component-local specification. Unsupported thresholds are N/A only when the authoritative capability/spec proves it. Exact component/spec/tool values are runtime prerequisites.
decision_basis: XLSX row 872, same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2, Script reference, selection manifest and historical record were directly reviewed.
DCSCM is component-scoped; correct evidence must bind FRU/instance and sensing point, not a similar label or room-ambient reference.
Threshold completeness means all implemented/required capability fields, not fabricated values in unsupported slots.
ED-13 governs N/A proof, ED-15 requires the versioned expected matrix, ED-17 rejects unrelated clearing and ED-35 preserves read-only coverage without inventing heat stimulus.

test_case.test_name: Verify TEMP_DCSCM for the exact FRU/instance against complete WebUI/OOB and component specification
test_case.purpose: Verify the temperature sensor owned by the intended DCSCM FRU/board instance is human readable in Hardware Status > Sensors and that its stable identity, component-local Celsius reading, units/scaling, health, implemented thresholds/hysteresis and freshness match the versioned DCSCM/platform specification under the recorded load/airflow condition.
required_package: Exact DCSCM product/FRU/serial/instance, chassis slot/topology, component firmware and BMC/WebUI/SDR revisions
Stable sensor number/name/type/entity/instance/resource and physical sensing-point mapping to DCSCM inventory and one UI row
Expected component-local range, Celsius scaling/rounding, sensor accuracy/tolerance, update period and approved operating load/airflow condition
Implemented threshold capability mask, lower/upper values, hysteresis, health/status and unavailable/not-readable/N/A semantics
Authoritative DCSCM sensor/thermal specification and any required approved on-board/physical reference method
Validated protected OOB/API/browser client plus pinned reviewed `sensor.git` revision/checksum or approved manual read-only method
test_case.test_command: Do not clear logs, force temperature, alter airflow/fans, acknowledge alarms or write thresholds. Bind the exact DCSCM FRU/serial/instance and physical sensing point to one stable SDR/API object and Hardware Status > Sensors row; stop on aliases, multiple modules or entity mismatch. Review the pinned Script before use. Record component/BMC firmware, chassis load/airflow and BMC time; capture the full object with identity, Celsius reading/scaling, capability mask, all applicable threshold/hysteresis fields, status and timestamp without truncation, then capture the same UI row/refresh time. Compare only applicable fields against the versioned DCSCM specification and approved condition/tolerance, treating N/A separately from missing required data. Reread only for the defined freshness check, never as automatic failure retry.
test_case.expected_result: One unique sensor is proven to belong to the intended DCSCM FRU/instance and sensing point. Complete OOB and WebUI fields agree within approved scaling/rounding/freshness rules and the reading, health plus every implemented/required threshold match the component specification for the recorded operating condition. Unsupported fields are N/A only with capability/spec proof. No log, alarm, airflow, temperature or threshold mutation occurs.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact FRU/topology/sensor/UI ownership, complete nontruncated capability-aware OOB and UI evidence, versioned component matrix, recorded load/airflow, approved tolerance and field-level agreement with engineer verdict. A label match, room ambient, plausible Celsius value, truncated list or invented threshold cannot pass. Wrong instance, identity ambiguity, stale data, unjustified N/A, missing required threshold, out-of-range/status mismatch or mutation is FAIL. Missing FRU mapping/spec/method is NOT READY, not Pending or PASS; active thermal behavior is not claimed.
safety_gate: Do not clear SEL/system logs; history may explain DCSCM thermal state.
Do not infer DCSCM instance or sensing point from the label; require FRU/topology/entity mapping and stop on ambiguity.
Do not compare board-local temperature directly with room ambient unless the specification explicitly defines equivalence.
Do not invent unsupported thresholds; N/A requires capability and specification proof, while missing required fields fail.
Do not heat/cool the module, obstruct airflow, change thresholds or acknowledge alarms; active behavior requires a separate approved test.
Do not truncate output, expose passwords, assume cipher 17 or run an unreviewed Script; stop without retry on identity/freshness disagreement.
expected_evidence: Stable sensor-to-DCSCM/UI map and complete raw identity/capability/reading/units/threshold/hysteresis/status/timestamp
Hardware Status > Sensors DOM/screenshot tied to the same component and refresh time
Versioned component expected matrix, recorded load/airflow and approved tolerance calculation with N/A justification
Pinned Script revision/checksum/content review or signed alternate method and protected command audit
No-clear/no-write/no-stimulus/no-retry proof, BMC/component health, discrepancies and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: No mutation is expected. On FRU/sensor ambiguity, stale/mismatched data or unexpected alarm/state change, stop and preserve first evidence; use the approved vendor/OOB diagnostic path without forcing temperature or acknowledging/clearing alarms. If tooling mutates state, isolate it and have the authorized owner restore the baseline.

source_conflict.reason: Items, Sensor Page procedure and Criteria consistently define read-only DCSCM temperature/spec validation. Component mapping and expected limits are readiness inputs.

blocked.reason: Target class and read-only comparison are clear. DCSCM instance, sensor map, spec and reviewed method can be supplied without a new engineering decision.
